title: Career - Why haven't I succeeded yet? (Porch photo)

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why haven't I succeeded yet?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I've worked so hard. I did everything right.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Who told you that you're behind?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Everyone around me. Their timeline. Their life.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Whose plan are you living — theirs, or the one made for you?

lines.speaker: verse
lines.text: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: So... my timeline isn't late. It's just mine?

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What if you're not behind — you're just not there yet? Share your answer in the comments.
